Class Modifier

java.lang.Object
greenfoot.World
Modifier
public class Modifier extends greenfoot.World

Modifier world which allows the user to change the startup value of the simulation. The user is allowed to modify the listed value below:

  • Number of days (int numDays)
  • Average IQ of students in the simulation (int studentIQ)
  • Mr.Cohen's computer breaking chance (int laptopBreakingChance)
  • Chance of customer support gets back to Mr.Cohen(customerSupportRespondChance)
  • Activation of chaos mode (boolean chaosMode)
  • Whether or not the simulation has robber (boolean robbers)
  • Whether or not the simulation has janitor (boolean janitors)
  • Mr.Cohen's startgin device (int computerType)
